frozen_campaign.scope: New signal handling is on develop; original and queued generation comparisons retain their original implementation.

independent_review: Root read the implementation and real-process tests, then ran the entire suite separately from the implementation agent.
scope_limits: Cooperative cancellation at Python work boundaries during setup/evaluation
SIGKILL cannot be handled; uninterruptible kernel tasks may not be reaped immediately
Atomic per-file replacement is not a multi-file transaction or automatic resume facility
Engineering validation does not establish molecular activity or experimental synthesizability
validated_behaviors: Actual SIGTERM/SIGINT to a CLI runner exit 143/130 after saving the interrupted attempt
TERM-resistant grandchildren are killed even after the leader exits; unrelated process remains alive
Interrupted worker output stays empty despite a plausible raw response file, whose hash is retained
Observed process-tree memory/CPU samples remain available
Repeated signals retain the first signal and do not break cleanup/checkpointing
No new attempt starts after cancellation during setup, worker monitoring, evaluation or checkpointing
Completed worker outcomes are preserved when termination arrives during subsequent cleanup/evaluation/checkpointing
Prior signal handlers are restored on success, interruption and unrelated exceptions
Library use outside the main thread rejects before starting work
